balls.text: it isn't a no ball from RP, but it is a low full toss that has been worked into the gap between deep midwicket and long on, there is a direct hit, but the non-striker has made it back
RP gets away with a high full toss, Irfan slices it straight to the sweeper
another one, Irfan has come in smokin' em off the middle, in the slot, pitched up on the stumps, and he's carted it over long on
swing and a miss to a slow short of a length ball outside off
Irfan times one more, overpitched on the stumps, and he;s lifted it wide of long on
Irfan is timing almost everything, sends a full delivery hurtling to extra cover, who lets it slip through
fine effort by Rahul at deep square leg, he went for the catch, dived forward, but Jadhav's hook  bounced just in front
that'll go over, Jadhav gets under an overpitched one outside off and cracks it out of wide long off's reach, it's hit a cheerleader
blasts a length ball down to long on
low and full outside off, slog produces a thick inside edge to square leg
swings an overpitched ball along the ground to wide long on
Irfan pulls his first ball off the front foot over square leg and it rolls into the boundary

Mahela has to go back, seems he;s been there for an age, never got going, but what an unfortunate end, Jadhav has connected with the slog, the ball is headed down the ground, but it has clipped Vinay's boot in his followthrough and crashed into Mahela's stumps
gets one away finally, walks down again and has a slog, thick inside edge runs past short fine
can;t get bat to ball, as he walks out and swings at a length ball
super, Vinay hits the blockhole again, and a disappointed Mahela, despite clearing front leg, can only dig it out
short, into the batsman, Mahela tried to make room and dab it over the keeper, but missed
comes out, but this is aimed around the blockhole, and he digs it out for one
carves a length delivery to sweeper cover
walks out and picks it in the air off the pads, deep midwicket gets around to it
wide length ball slashed to the sweeper
high full toss, Mahela steers, and Vinay lets it go though his hands at third man
hit hard down the ground, AB with a slide cuts off the boundary
overpitched around off, but he cannot time the straight hit well enough
he's made room and timed the late cut pretty well but third man is quick to run and dive
back of a length close to off, he chops it towards short third man, keeper fields
backs away to leg, Vinay angled it in though, and he can only lift it to long on
steers this length ball to the right of third man for two
walks across and outside off and turns it to square leg
length outside off, he's run that very fine past a diving keeper
worked off the pad to square leg

slow length ball cutting across on off, turned square on leg, there's a direct hit at the striker's, but no harm done, was much closer than it looked, though, replays show though he was nearly past the stumps, both feet were in the air, and he hadn't grounded his bat
how many times has Mahela run the ball to point today, one more for the collection
pitched up slowish around off, can;t do anything with it
back of a length, worked in front of square leg
Unadkat gets a gift of a wicket and lets out a roar, Rohrer's cracked this short ball right off the middle, and picked out Kohli at deep midwicket with a flat hit
slams this overpitched one to mid off and rushes for the single, makes it very comfortably despite the direct hit
Mahela drops this length ball behind point, Kohli goes at the on-striker's end, Mahela was struggling had that hit
closes the face and forces an overpitched ball to wide long on
nicely placed, walks out to a short ball and swipes it past square leg's dive
pitched up, cracked straight to cover on the edge of the circle
ends up pushing inside the line of a length ball
mishits a slog to the right of midwicket and scrambles for the single
width with the angle across, and he places the cut wide of the sweeper, though not with much power
fast and flat into the pads, he cannot connect as he tries to force to leg
turned to short fine this time
gets this away, flat around the pads and he helps it wristily past short fine, and it beats deep square;s dive too
Mahela is having problems with the running as well, dabs this last to backward point and has to really hurry in the end
walks out to a short one to pull, it comes in and he hits it to Kohli at midwicket
Mahela can't time it at the moment, tries to work to leg, takes the run as it rolls to off
shortish outside off, and he swivels eagerly to pull past midwicket
about four men, four of them converge to field this inside edge to backward square leg, one fumbles, another picks it up, the rest have a laugh about it
pitched up this time and swung straight down to long on, tried to launch it down the ground, could not get enough on it
he;s dropping the bouncer too short, this one is called for height
opens up and tucks a length ball through square leg
tries to dab it late, but cannot time it, it rolls to short third
angled in from wide of the crease, he moves across to work to leg
flat and widish, he flashes it to extra cover
angled in full on off, Mahela comes forward and nudges it to leg for a single
darted in full, forced down to long off
opens the face and runs a length ball on off, to third man
digs it too short and down the leg side
cut away to sweeper cover
can't get it past Kohli at the moment, Mahela wants the single, Juneja sends him back, Mahela tries one more time, before he turns back, throw misses
pushed away and finds Kohli at point once more
tried to steer it past point, but did not have the width to time it, Kohli cuts it off there
short from over the stumps, he gets on his toes and tucks it square
stretches out to a widish one and drives it to wide long off
overpitched and angled in now, he flicks, Kohli is there at midwicket, but this is hit several feet above him
drills an overpitched delivery wide of the sweeper, but not enough to get the second
suffles shuffles across and works a length ball square to leg
full and wide, and he's sliced this high over point for a one bounce four
very full, hit hard into the pitch, and back to the bowler
moves forward to a length ball and pushes to extra cover
drops a length ball behind point, Gayle, who's at that very wide slip, runs forward to deny them the single

Mahela's cut this into the ground, it's bounced over point, sweeper's come around to it, but the action is on the second run, as Mahela realises he'd better hurry if he has to beat the throw, he dives into the crease, and is about a frame in
sharp, that took off, Mahela decided early to sway out of the line
width on a length, flashed wide of the sweeper on the boundary
defended off the front foot to off
widish and short, steered to third man
pushed softly in front of cover for one
pitched up, caressed off the front foot, and it disappears past extra cover
overpitched, eased to mid on, non-striker eager for one, sent back
wow, gentle length ball angled in, and Sehwag flicks it into the captain's hands at midwicket, not much of a sendoff from his Delhi [Ranji] team-mate this time, Kohli is just delighted
gets across and drives a length ball, to cover

Vinay gets a rocket launched back at him, just to his left, and his reflexes are sharp enough to pluck it, and his adrenalin charged enough to smack it into the ground, boy, Warner had flat-batted the length ball savagely
good length, on the pads, worked to deep square
stays in the crease and swats a length delivery to mid on
short, too short from Vinay around off, Sehwag lets it go, but he isn;t getting support from the square leg umpire, who just signals one for the over
sharp, pacy bouncer into Warner, who takes eyes off the ball and hooks, it hits the helmet and flies fine on off past the keeper, given as runs
no room at all this time, back of a length on middle, Sehwag turns it to midwicket
free hit is a slower and fuller one, Warner's heave produces an inside edge behind square leg
Gayle is at a very wide slip, and Sehwag's punch has ended up as a thick edge and fallen just short of him now
just stood there and crashed this pitched up ball, it fell short of AB at extra cover, who did well to stop it
charges out, and misses a rising back of a length ball by a couple of miles
slower length ball, he waits for it and pushes in front of covers for one
gets better, not much more width on this one, but Sehwag has dropped wrists on it so precisely, it has beaten third man to his left easily
lovely timing, vintage Sehwag, needs only inches around off stump and sends a length ball racing to the deep point boundary
almost popped back to the bowler, it was slower from short of a length, Sehwag across to turn it to leg, ended up stabbing it down the pitch
good length, Sehwag takes a step out and lifts this casually over the man at mid on
tight, it held its line from back of a length, Sehwag was expecting more width, and tried cutting it in the end, chopped it into the pitch
slight width and Sehwag awkwardly steers it to third man
bouncer now, around off, Sehwag hurried into a flail, in no position to connect
this time he connects but punches a length ball straight to cover
back of a length and climbing outside off, widish alright, Sehwag wants to crack it over point, but cannot connect, too much bounce
Warner makes up his mind early about the swing through leg, and underedges the length ball through square leg
angled into the pads, Sehwag works it behind square and it travels slowly enough for them to come back for three by the time fine leg reaches it
this will go as well, Warner does not hold back this time, and a length ball disappears to the deep cover rope
now he waits, width again from RP, and Warner calmly eases it past covers
big attempted drive but he misses the good length outswinger

run out chance missed, Sehwag guided a length ball behind point, Rahul had a straightforward pick up, Warner was two-thirds of the way up the pitch, but Rahul fumbled, the ball rolled away, and a single was given away as well
that'll be four, McDonald gives up pretty early from short fine leg, pitching outside leg and moving down the pads, Sehwag tickles behind square
outswinger from a good length again, Warner can't get any timing as he moves across, takes the run to extra cover with an awkward swat
away swinger wide outside off, Warner goes hard at it, but it is too far away
Sehwag spots width, flashes, and misses an away going, bouncing ball
goes deep in the crease and defends a length ball right on middle stump
Warner can;t get bat to ball at the moment, he makes do with the pads again, a length ball hits them and rolls fine down leg
and again, good length now, shaping in once more, Warner hit on the pad as he fails to tuck it to leg
this moved in as well, and bounced a lot more, catching him by surprise and hitting the thigh pad to roll to off
swinging in from just short of a good length, Warner defends tightly to the leg side
we have a Super Over, Rampaul has missed again, but they have kept RCB in it with a scampered bye
dot ball, dot ball, Rampaul swings and misses a length delivery outside off
Nadeem has raced across from long off and slid to save the boundary off a Rampaul straight hit, two taken
it is a high full toss but Vinay's flat-batted it straight down to long off
overpitched, he cannot get under it this time, and belts it down to long off
Ravi Rampaul has Virat Kohli on his feet in the dugout, this is full and wide, and he's scythed it flat and just over the deep extra cover boundary, Chinnaswamy roars as the umpire raises his hands
pitched up, hit down to long on
full and widish, squeezes a couple wide of third man

that has to be it, what a meltdown, absolute meltdown, Virat is furious at having done this, he's smashed this overpitched delivery in the air, and Mahela has made no mistake to his left at extra cover, Kohli swishes his bat violently a couple of times and walks back, mouthing anything and everything that comes to his mind
RCB are crumbling like a sand castle, Syed Mohammad tries to get under a length ball, but he's slogged it straight to Warner at long on
hammers a low full toss to long on
hit high on the pad as he misses the work to leg, and they change ends

madness, Arun Karthik made some room and swung over mid on, Irfan chased all the way and pulled it back just inside, Karthik was happy with two, Kohli would have been on strike next over, but Virat wanted the third, Karthik was too late to start and Morkel did the rest
opened him up with one holding its line, thick edge to backward point
pushed  behind point for one
direct hit and he was stranded miles outside, pushed one to backward point and set off, Warner just missed, they take the overthrow
full into the pads, turned in the air to deep square
presses forward and squeezes this length ball down to third man
quick and spinning away outside off, defended
punched back to the bowler from the crease
stayed in the crease to one floated up fullish, stabbed it to off in the end
this push was in the air for a long time, but there was no mid off, long off fields
another one, nothing shot from McDonald, hes skipped out and popped this length ball straight back to the bowler
pushes a quick and full one to extra cover
that is gone, AB is running straight off, he took on Morne from mid off after a forcing hit to the fast bowler, was always going to struggle, and this was a direct hit
tries the bouncer, AB is on top of it with a pull into the ground, on the bounce to a diving midwicket
good length, turned wide of midwicket
played by one on top of his game, takes a step out and flays it on the bounce to point
tucks a back of a length ball to square leg and races back, top running
keeper takes this down the leg side, but that is off the thigh pad
short of a length, guided down to third man
just goes through the line with a forcing push, to sweeper cover
squeezes it from off stump behind point with an open face
good length, he runs it to backward point
dismissive, slightly short and he pounces on it, smacking it off the front foot, one bounce over the deep midwicket rope
allows a length ball to come on and plays it out to point
floats it down leg from a good length
solid push off the front foot, extra cover's dive saves some runs
on the pads once more, they collect another couple with a work behind square leg
short, down the leg side, and he dismisses it to the fine leg rope, one more fifty for the RCB captain
direct hit was needed, Rohrer dived and stopped a solid punch to his right, but he was off balance as he threw at the non-striker's
flays a length ball off the inner part of the bat past forward square leg for two more
moves in on a length, but it starts outside leg and is turned square for a couple
angled in on a length, Kohli does the late opening movement and swat routine again, deep midwicket fields
eases a push to backward point
that turned, past the outside edge just outside off
goes deep to whip it from off to deep midwicket
not happening for DD, a drive in the air falls inches short of extra cover
makes some room and cuts, short extra dives and stops it
overpitched, he smacks it with the bottom hand but mid off gets around
pushed in front of cover
murdered over point, AB stepping it up against his South Africa team mate with a sharp cut with a widish length ball
worked with the angle into him in front of square leg
eases a pitched up ball to sweeper cover
overpitched, pushed to extra cover
does it again, it is on a length but he is sharp enough to react late and pull to deep midwicket
Nehra at long on lets it go through on the tumble, it was a length ball but Kohli waited deep in the crease and opened up late to swat it through midwicket
stayed in the crease as this came in with the angle, thick inside edge towards midwicket
pushed down the ground for a single
he cuts, a big, thick under edge races fine past short third
width but he's slapped it straight to backward point
overpitched around off, driven wide of the sweeper
turned behind square leg

that was quite fast from Umesh, short too, but how well has Kohli played it, he was not in a great position as it almost reached him, but swivelled swiftly in the end to pull it away, deep square leg did not have to move too much to his right, no chance
slowish but into the pads, turned to deep midwicket
length ball angled in to off, and they've pinched two with an awkward work behind square leg
down the track and lofts it straight down the ground, well clear of long on
whipped off the pad to deep midwicket
swats a tossed up ball to wide long off
going back to a pitched up ball and punching to the bowler
gets inside the line and drives to the sweeper
tossed up full on off, pushed to long off
sweet, AB on the knee and pinging the deep extra cover rope
length ball moving down the pads, turned square
pushed down to long off
works a back of a length ball through square leg, first is taken safely, lots of confusion in going for the second, and they abort mission in the end
slight width and Kohli has cut this very hard past backward point;s dive
stands in the crease and punches a length ball to sweeper cover
slow length ball now, turned through midwicket again
worked out to deep midwicket
ripper takes off from back of a length, and has Kohli smelling the white as it whizzes past
goes reaching at a low and wide full toss, thick inside edge to square leg
pitched up and angled in, he;s driving them nicely, this one goes to extra cover
drives a widish length ball, wide of third man
pushed back to the bowler
exquisite, AB has used the angle across, and despite no width, has sent it crisply into the gap at extra cover with a meaty punch
driven down to mid on
almost played on, goes forward with an angled bat at a pitched up ball, inside edge bounces between him and the stumps
right forward to push to covers
gentle length ball, but he;s not gone too hard at it as well, punched it into the ground and to cover on the bounce
over backward point, AB getting down on the knee and slicing it high, and his timing is almost always special
gets forward and opens the face as he drives, to point
opens the face and runs it to third man
lovely, sharp, bouncing length ball, he steers it late and wrists it to the third man rope
pushes forward neatly, to covers
thick inside edge behind the stumps as he pushes at one angled across

all happening, Kohli confidently pushes through extra cover, the chase is long but fruitful as  run is saved. Kohli rams into the umpire on the third, and is left rubbing his shoulder, umpire Erasmus took the brunt of the impact with Kohli's helmet, wonder how's doing
turned  behind square leg, Kohli has to really tear back for the second as he realises the throw is coming in fast
misses the work off the pad and takes the single as it dribbles to leg
Umesh takes his engagement gift from Gayle, who flays at a fuller one, and it goes screaming down to Umesh at third man
Gayle wins the second exchange easily, he backs away to leg, and slices a rising back of a length ball over backward point, should have ,measured the reaction time for the crowd in that area
Morne wins the first exchange of the over, beats Gayle on the cut with a quick shortish one angled across
his chancy stay is over, and Nehra waves him off, tries to slog a length ball and top-edges it tamely to mid on
a thick inside edge now, fine leg cuts it off, but Nehra is still ruing that denied lbw
beaten this time, Nehra's clocked at 143.7 kph, #justsaying, length ball bouncing and anlging past the outside edge as he prods from the crease
another one, Nehra goes full and wide, but Rahul reaches it and carves it over point
Rahul connects, backs away and lofts a length ball mighty cleanly over extra cover
chopped towards slip
hows that for response, he's tested Gayle through the over, but Gayle's hit back last ball with a swift, late burst of a bat-swing to lift a length ball flat over long on
fast and fullish down the leg side
back of a length, climbing outside off, Gayle brings it down with an angled bat towards point
this time he fishes for it close to off, but it zips through and moves slightly away past the outside edge
slanted wider across Gayle, who makes no attempt to reach it
angled across on a length, Gayle lets it go
Rahul is all at sea, this rises from back of a length, and a thick inside edge runs to fine leg
worked behind square leg off the pad
pushed back to the bowler

Nehra shouts and shouts, but umpire Kulkarni shakes his head, that was dead plumb, pitching on leg, straightening and hitting him in front of middle and leg as he goes back in the crease, nothing wrong with the height, nothing wrong with anything
straightening around off, and pushed awkwardly towards cover
swings in and catches him by surprise, flicks the pad on its way to the keeper
straightening and bouncing outside off, he moves across to push for a single behind point
